findings.desc: dead-code: tasks/experience-layer-effectiveness-smoke.ts:116-119 declares a `stories: EffStory[]` fixture (S0/S1 with tag X) that is immediately suppressed with `void stories` on line 127 and never used in any assertion — should be deleted

type-safety / misleading-field: core/experience-effectiveness.ts:231 `precision: ratio(preWarnable, preWarnable)` always evaluates to 1 or 0 by construction (ratio of a number with itself). The PredictiveValueReport interface exposes `precision` as a meaningful metric, but it carries no information beyond `preWarnable > 0`. JSON consumers reading the output would be misled into treating it as a genuine IR precision score. The field should either be removed from the interface or its degenerate-constant nature must be made explicit in the interface name/type (e.g., rename to `precisionNote` with a string, or remove and keep only `recall`).
